citations.line: Romulus and Remus, warriors of light
Romulus and Remus fought with pride
Romulus declared with voice so strong:
Romulus in anger gouged the eyes
But Romulus climbed up into the day
Yet Romulus was torn apart ere long,
From Romulus' fight with his own brother
Of all humans. Romulus and Remus in the Roman tradition—where
Cosmogonic payoff is attenuated. Romulus kills Remus and founds
Romulus—is legendary, but archaeological evidence does show
